prologue.skytest.title: Vision
prologue.skytest.line1: Cast off the shackles of sleep.
prologue.skytest.line2: The time has come for you to ascend.
prologue.skytest.line3: Find me at the top of the world.
area.skytest.lower_prison.subtitle: The very bottom of the world
area.skytest.test_end.subtitle: Test area complete. To be continued...
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.greeting: Hush... Don't get up so fast. You slept for a long time. (Right-click to talk)
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.1: The light spoke to you? I can see it in your eyes. It only speaks to those who are meant to rise.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.2: This is the Lower Prison. The very bottom of the world. No one has ever climbed out of here.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.3: Your door is not locked. I saw to that... Don't ask what it cost me.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.4: In the open cell across the corridor lie old boots. Their owner once danced beneath the circus dome. He won't need them anymore.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.5: Past the corridor is a great hall. On the ledge lies something that will help you cling to life. Quite literally.
dialogue.skytest.lamplighter.6: Go. My light will wait for you here.
